the role of the middleman in transnational migration is ambivalent and complex.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the role and practices of brokers are not black and white.
brokers and recruitment agencies have an ambivalent position in the migration process, which needs to be taken into account in migration research, policy and practice.
migration brokers and agencies are not only a necessary evil but can also play an important role for the facilitation and regulation of labour migration.

the brokers in the middle space are important actors in the facilitation of migration and should be included in migration research and policy.
